title: V-STaR: Training Verifiers for Self-Taught Reasoners
authors_zh: Arian Hosseini、Xingdi Yuan、Nikolay Malkin、Aaron Courville、Alessandro Sordoni、Rishabh Agarwal
paper_type_zh: 迭代自训练与结果验证器数据配方
best_for_zh: 研究 rejection sampling、synthetic preference、outcome verifier、DPO 与 test-time compute 的读者
one_line: V-STaR keeps correct self-generated solutions for iterative generator SFT and converts correct-versus-incorrect outcomes into DPO verifier pairs for Best-of-k ranking.
V-STaR 将正确的自生成解用于迭代式 generator SFT，并把同题正确—错误结果转换为 DPO verifier pairs，以支持 Best-of-k 排序。
why: It shows how rejected generations can become reusable verifier supervision and how generator refresh changes negative examples, while making terminal-label noise, Cartesian-pair correlation, score gaming, and inference budget explicit audit objects.
inclusion_reason: V-STaR is a clean verifier-data recipe: it preserves rejected self-generated reasoning, converts programmatic outcomes into synthetic same-query preferences, refreshes the negative distribution through iterative generators, and uses the resulting verifier for adaptive test-time selection while exposing outcome-label and pairing risks.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Self-improvement methods such as STaR and rejection-sampling fine-tuning keep model-generated solutions only when a terminal check marks them correct. On difficult tasks, most sampled solutions may be wrong, so this discards the majority of the generation budget and loses information about recurring failure patterns. Separately trained outcome verifiers can reuse wrong solutions, but a verifier trained once on a frozen generator may not see the harder or more varied errors produced by later generators.

V-STaR asks whether the same iterative sampling process can improve both sides of the system: a generator that learns from successful self-generated solutions and a verifier that learns to distinguish successful from failed solutions. The setting is intentionally narrow and auditable—GSM8K mathematics with reference answers and MBPP code with executable tests—so every complete candidate receives a binary terminal label.

The key data question is not simply whether incorrect outputs are retained. It is how terminal labels become preference pairs, how the candidate distribution changes across iterations, what score the verifier actually exposes, and whether that score remains reliable under larger Best-of-k search. Final-answer and test labels are cheap, but they do not validate intermediate reasoning or guarantee robust program semantics.

STaR 和 rejection-sampling fine-tuning 等自我改进方法只在终局检查判定模型生成解正确时才保留该解。对于困难任务，大部分采样解可能都是错误的，因此这种做法既浪费了多数生成预算，也丢失了反复出现的失败模式。单独训练的 outcome verifier 可以复用错误解，但如果 verifier 只在一个冻结 generator 的输出上训练，它可能看不到后续 generator 产生的更难或更多样的错误。

V-STaR 研究同一个迭代采样过程能否同时改善系统的两侧：generator 从成功的自生成解中学习，verifier 则学习区分成功和失败的解。其设置有意保持狭窄且可审计——GSM8K 数学使用 reference answer，MBPP 代码使用 executable tests——因此每个完整候选都能获得一个 binary terminal label。

关键数据问题不只是是否保留错误输出，还包括 terminal label 如何转换为 preference pair、候选分布如何随迭代变化、verifier 实际暴露什么 score，以及在扩大 Best-of-k search 时该 score 是否仍可靠。final-answer label 和 test label 成本低，但它们不能验证中间推理，也不能保证稳健的程序语义。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
V-STaR maintains two buffers. D_GEN contains the original supervised solutions and all self-generated solutions labeled correct; it trains the next generator. D_VER contains the original solutions plus every labeled generation, correct or incorrect. After iterative collection, solutions for the same problem are expanded into every correct-versus-incorrect combination, producing synthetic preference pairs for a DPO-trained verifier.

The verifier is a language model, not a scalar classification head. DPO raises the likelihood of correct solutions relative to incorrect solutions under an SFT reference policy. At inference, the likelihood of a complete candidate given the problem is used as its ranking score; the highest-scoring candidate in a sampled set is selected. The native objects are therefore a terminal binary label, a same-query pairwise preference, and a learned sequence-likelihood score.

The main loop does not let the learned verifier decide which examples are correct. GSM8K final answers and MBPP test execution provide the construction labels, while the verifier is trained after accumulating the buffers. An optional verifier-in-the-loop experiment is separate and produces no substantial MBPP gain. This separation reduces direct feedback-loop gaming during data collection, but it does not remove terminal-label error or test-time score gaming.

V-STaR 维护两个 buffer。D_GEN 保存原始监督解和所有被标为正确的自生成解，用于训练下一轮 generator。D_VER 保存原始解以及所有带标签的生成，无论正确或错误。完成迭代采集后，同一道题的解被展开为全部正确—错误组合，形成用于 DPO verifier 的 synthetic preference pairs。

该 verifier 是 language model，而不是 scalar classification head。DPO 相对于一个 SFT reference policy 提高正确解对错误解的 likelihood。推理时，完整候选在给定问题下的 likelihood 就是 ranking score；系统从采样集合中选择得分最高的候选。因此原生对象分别是 terminal binary label、同题 pairwise preference 和学习得到的 sequence-likelihood score。

主循环不让学习得到的 verifier 决定哪些样本正确。GSM8K final answer 与 MBPP test execution 提供构造标签，verifier 则在 buffer 累积完成后训练。可选的 verifier-in-the-loop 实验属于单独变体，且没有带来显著的 MBPP 增益。这种分离减少了数据采集阶段的直接 feedback-loop gaming，但不能消除 terminal-label error 或测试时的 score gaming。

title: Method
方法
html:
The mathematics pipeline uses GSM8K training problems and original rationales; the code pipeline uses MBPP training tasks and reference programs. For GSM8K, the first generator is LLaMA2 SFT-trained on the original data for 2 epochs. For MBPP, iteration 1 samples with a 3-shot prompt from pretrained CodeLLaMA, and Appendix B publishes that prompt. Experiments adapt 7B and 13B LLaMA2 or CodeLLaMA models with LoRA.

Main experiments run 3 iterations. At each iteration, the current generator samples 16 complete solutions per training query. A math solution is positive when its extracted final answer equals the reference answer; a code solution is positive when it passes all invoked tests. Positives are added to D_GEN; positives and negatives are added to D_VER. The next generator is trained from the pretrained base model on the enlarged D_GEN, then supplies the following round's 16 samples. This yields a nominal 48 self-generated candidates per query.

For each query, the verifier dataset takes the Cartesian product of available correct and incorrect solutions. The SFT model trained on original data is the DPO reference; its original training lasts 2 epochs for GSM8K and 3 for MBPP. DPO increases verifier likelihood for the correct member relative to the incorrect member. The paper does not disclose learning rates, batches, LoRA ranks, selected DPO beta, sequence limits, hardware, generation temperature, seeds, deduplication, pair balancing, or pair subsampling.

At inference, the generator produces 128 candidates per test problem. The paper estimates Best-of-64 from that fixed pool with a combinatorial formula after sorting candidates by verifier score; the formula assumes no tied scores. A separate GSM8K scaling plot subsamples from 1,000 generations. Best-of-1 ignores the verifier and equals generator Pass@1, while the main 7B curves saturate at k of at least 16.

The optional verifier-in-loop study differs from the main recipe: it samples 64 MBPP completions, retains the top 8 by verifier score, and adds enough incorrect examples to cap the retained set at 16 per query. The authors find no substantial gain, so the simpler programmatically labeled loop remains the recommended version in the paper.

数学流水线使用 GSM8K 训练题和原始 rationale；代码流水线使用 MBPP 训练任务和 reference program。对于 GSM8K，第一个 generator 是在原始数据上 SFT 2 epochs 的 LLaMA2。对于 MBPP，第 1 轮使用 pretrained CodeLLaMA 的 3-shot prompt 采样，Appendix B 公开了该 prompt。实验通过 LoRA 适配 7B 和 13B 的 LLaMA2 或 CodeLLaMA。

主实验运行 3 轮。每一轮中，当前 generator 为每道训练题采样 16 个完整解。数学解的 extracted final answer 与 reference answer 相等时为 positive；代码解通过所有被调用测试时为 positive。positive 加入 D_GEN，positive 与 negative 都加入 D_VER。下一轮 generator 从 pretrained base model 出发，在扩大的 D_GEN 上训练，再为下一轮提供 16 个样本。因此每道题的名义自生成候选总数为 48。

对每道题，verifier dataset 取所有可用正确解与错误解的 Cartesian product。原始数据上训练的 SFT model 是 DPO reference；其原始训练在 GSM8K 上为 2 epochs，在 MBPP 上为 3 epochs。DPO 提高正确成员相对于错误成员的 verifier likelihood。论文没有披露 learning rate、batch、LoRA rank、选定的 DPO beta、sequence limit、hardware、generation temperature、seed、deduplication、pair balancing 或 pair subsampling。

推理时，generator 为每个 test problem 生成 128 个候选。论文按 verifier score 排序后，用组合公式从这个固定 pool 估计 Best-of-64；该公式假设不存在 score tie。另一个 GSM8K scaling 图从 1,000 次生成中做 subsampling。Best-of-1 忽略 verifier，等于 generator Pass@1；主实验的 7B 曲线在 k 至少为 16 时趋于饱和。

可选的 verifier-in-loop 研究与主配方不同：它采样 64 个 MBPP completions，按 verifier score 保留 top 8，并加入足够的错误样本，把每题保留集上限设为 16。作者没有观察到显著增益，因此论文仍推荐更简单的 programmatically labeled loop。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports experiments on GSM8K and MBPP, with transfer evaluation on a 150-problem numeric-answer, no-LaTeX, Level 1 MATH subset and the full HumanEval test set. Across 7B and 13B runs, the reported absolute improvement over prior self-improvement or verification baselines is 6-17 percentage points on math and 4-12 points on code. These numbers measure the combined generator, verifier, and inference-budget recipe, not the quality of every label or preference pair.

Budget-matched comparisons support the iterative collection claim. V-STaR outperforms a one-iteration generator-plus-verifier baseline that draws all 48 candidates from the initial SFT generator. On MBPP, verifier improvements across iterations are larger than generator improvements; a fourth iteration adds only 0.3 points, indicating diminishing marginal returns in that setup.

Under the authors' LoRA implementation and matched training data, the DPO verifier ranks candidates better than their ORM-style baseline as search grows: ORM stops searching effectively beyond 4 candidates on GSM8K and is worse than DPO beyond 16 on MBPP. This is an objective-and-implementation comparison inside one study, not evidence that every DPO verifier dominates every ORM.

The optional verifier-in-loop MBPP variant reports 53.2 Best-of-64 and 46.34 Pass@1 after 3 iterations, but the authors conclude that it gives no substantial gain. Test-time curves also show that Best-of-k saturates at k of at least 16 and that V-STaR's advantage over majority voting narrows at larger k. These findings expose both the value and the limit of additional inference compute.

Reproducibility evidence is incomplete. The accepted COLM paper, full appendices, DOI, and paper license are verified, but no official implementation, generated buffer, pair manifest, project page, checkpoint, or Hugging Face release was confirmed. Results therefore cannot be independently tied to exact records, configurations, or model hashes.

论文在 GSM8K 和 MBPP 上实验，并在一个包含 150 道 numeric-answer、no-LaTeX、Level 1 题目的 MATH subset 和完整 HumanEval test set 上进行 transfer evaluation。在 7B 和 13B 实验中，相比已有 self-improvement 或 verification baselines，论文报告数学任务绝对提升 6-17 个百分点、代码任务提升 4-12 个百分点。这些数字测量的是 generator、verifier 与 inference budget 的组合配方，而不是每个 label 或 preference pair 的质量。

预算匹配比较支持迭代采集主张。V-STaR 优于一个从初始 SFT generator 一次性抽取全部 48 个候选的单轮 generator-plus-verifier baseline。在 MBPP 上，各轮 verifier 的提升大于 generator 的提升；第 4 轮仅增加 0.3 个百分点，说明该设置中边际收益递减。

在作者的 LoRA 实现和相同训练数据下，随着 search 扩大，DPO verifier 的候选排序优于其 ORM-style baseline：ORM 在 GSM8K 上超过 4 个候选后便不能有效 search，在 MBPP 上超过 16 个候选后弱于 DPO。这是在单篇研究中的 objective-and-implementation 对比，并不证明所有 DPO verifier 都优于所有 ORM。

可选的 verifier-in-loop MBPP 变体在 3 轮后报告 53.2 Best-of-64 与 46.34 Pass@1，但作者认为它没有带来显著增益。测试时曲线还显示 Best-of-k 在 k 至少为 16 时趋于饱和，而 V-STaR 相对 majority voting 的优势在更大 k 下缩小。这些发现同时揭示了额外 inference compute 的价值和上限。

复现证据仍不完整。已核验获 COLM 接收的论文、完整附录、DOI 和论文 license，但未确认官方实现、生成 buffer、pair manifest、project page、checkpoint 或 Hugging Face release。因此，实验结果无法独立绑定到精确记录、配置或模型 hash。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
V-STaR connects two previously separate uses of sampled reasoning. STaR-style self-training sends only correct solutions back to the generator, while outcome-verifier training keeps both correct and incorrect solutions for ranking. V-STaR accumulates both objects from a sequence of improving generators, so later rounds contribute a changing distribution of positives and negatives rather than one frozen-generator snapshot.

Its verifier objective is also distinctive for this setting. Instead of adding a binary ORM head, it converts programmatic outcome labels into same-problem correct-over-incorrect preferences and uses DPO to train a generative verifier. The resulting sequence likelihood is used directly for Best-of-k ranking. This makes rejected generations reusable without claiming that they are demonstrations to imitate.

The ingredients are not individually new: STaR, RFT, ReST-style iterative self-training, outcome reward models, DPO, unit-test verification, and Best-of-k selection all predate the paper. The contribution is the specific two-buffer iterative recipe, the synthetic pair transformation, and the matched evidence that refreshing generator errors improves the verifier under the tested math and code settings.

V-STaR 连接了 sampled reasoning 的两种原本分开的用途。STaR-style self-training 只把正确解送回 generator，而 outcome-verifier training 同时保存正确和错误解用于排序。V-STaR 从一系列逐步改善的 generator 中累积这两种对象，使后续轮次贡献不断变化的 positive 与 negative 分布，而不是一个 frozen-generator snapshot。

其 verifier objective 在这一设置中也有区别。方法没有添加 binary ORM head，而是把程序化 outcome label 转换为同题正确优于错误的 preferences，再使用 DPO 训练 generative verifier。得到的 sequence likelihood 直接用于 Best-of-k ranking。这样既能复用 rejected generations，又不会把错误解误当作应模仿的 demonstration。

各个组成部分并非全新：STaR、RFT、ReST-style iterative self-training、outcome reward model、DPO、unit-test verification 和 Best-of-k selection 都早于该论文。贡献在于具体的 two-buffer iterative recipe、synthetic pair transformation，以及在受测数学和代码设置下证明刷新 generator error 会改善 verifier 的预算匹配证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The verifier receives outcome supervision only. A GSM8K rationale can contain invalid steps yet end at the correct number, while a semantically equivalent answer can be rejected by an undisclosed extractor or formatting rule. MBPP test passing is bounded by available test coverage and can reward brittle or test-specific programs. The code sandbox, timeout, interpreter, dependency, exception, and resource policies are not documented.

Cartesian pairing creates correlated data. One solution may appear in many pairs, and problems with particular positive/negative balances can contribute many more pairs than others. The paper does not report per-iteration class counts, pair counts, deduplication, balancing, subsampling, or malformed-generation handling, so the effective training distribution cannot be reconstructed.

The learned signal is candidate sequence likelihood, not a calibrated probability of correctness. Length, formatting, and generator-specific style can affect that score. The paper does not specify length normalization, score calibration, tie handling, abstention, cross-generator evaluation, adversarial attacks, or a refresh policy. A generator optimized against the verifier could therefore exploit score shortcuts even though the main data-collection loop uses programmatic labels.

Best-of-k improvement is not free capability: the main result samples 128 candidates per problem to estimate Best-of-64, and a scaling analysis uses 1,000 generations. The estimator assumes no tied scores and measures selection within a fixed pool. It does not by itself establish online reliability under a new sampler or deployment budget.

Scope and release are narrow. Evidence covers grade-school mathematics and small Python functions with cheap binary outcomes, 7B/13B LoRA models, and named benchmarks. No open-ended judge task, process supervision, full-parameter training, or robust code environment is tested. No official code, generated data, pair manifest, checkpoint, exact prompt bundle, or full hyperparameter configuration was confirmed.

verifier 只接收 outcome supervision。GSM8K rationale 可以包含无效步骤却碰巧以正确数字结束，而语义等价的答案可能被未披露的 extractor 或 formatting rule 拒绝。MBPP test passing 受可用测试覆盖率限制，也可能奖励脆弱或针对测试的 program。code sandbox、timeout、interpreter、dependency、exception 和 resource policy 都没有记录。

Cartesian pairing 会产生相关数据。同一个解可能出现在许多 pair 中，而具有特定 positive/negative 比例的问题可能贡献多得多的 pair。论文没有报告逐轮 class count、pair count、deduplication、balancing、subsampling 或 malformed generation handling，因此无法重建有效训练分布。

学习信号是 candidate sequence likelihood，而不是校准后的正确概率。长度、格式和 generator-specific style 都可能影响该 score。论文没有说明 length normalization、score calibration、tie handling、abstention、cross-generator evaluation、adversarial attack 或 refresh policy。因此，针对 verifier 优化的 generator 仍可能利用 score shortcut，即使主数据采集循环使用 programmatic label。

Best-of-k 提升不是免费的能力：主结果为每道题采样 128 个候选以估计 Best-of-64，scaling analysis 则使用 1,000 次生成。estimator 假设没有 score tie，并且只测量固定 pool 内的 selection。它本身不能证明在新 sampler 或 deployment budget 下的在线可靠性。

范围和发布都很有限。证据仅覆盖可低成本获得 binary outcome 的 grade-school mathematics 与小型 Python function、7B/13B LoRA model 和具名 benchmark。没有测试 open-ended judge task、process supervision、full-parameter training 或稳健 code environment。也未确认官方代码、生成数据、pair manifest、checkpoint、完整 prompt bundle 或完整 hyperparameter configuration。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Preference and Reward Feedback Data track, V-STaR is a precise example of synthetic preference construction: binary programmatic outcomes are converted into correct-versus-incorrect pairs, and DPO trains a full-solution verifier whose native deployment signal is sequence likelihood. It helps readers distinguish a human preference, a terminal label, a DPO pair, an ORM score, and a Best-of-k selection score.

For the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, the two-buffer lineage is the main reusable lesson. Correct traces improve the generator; both accepted and rejected traces improve the verifier; later generator iterations refresh the error distribution. This recipe can guide self-training experiments wherever a reliable terminal predicate exists, including mathematics, code, formal proofs, or constrained tool tasks.

Responsible reuse requires rebuilding the missing audit layer. Pin source datasets and base checkpoints; save query IDs, generation seeds, iteration IDs, raw outcomes, execution errors, and pair provenance; measure label errors and pair imbalance; normalize and calibrate verifier scores; and test false positives, false negatives, and gaming on generators not seen during verifier training. Untrusted code must run in a documented sandbox.

The method should not be relabeled as process supervision or RLVR. It trains the generator with SFT, trains the verifier with offline DPO, and uses the verifier for test-time ranking. Extending it to policy optimization or open-ended feedback requires a new reward contract and new evidence.

对于 Preference and Reward Feedback Data 赛道，V-STaR 是 synthetic preference construction 的清晰样例：binary programmatic outcome 被转换为 correct-versus-incorrect pair，DPO 训练 full-solution verifier，其原生 deployment signal 是 sequence likelihood。它帮助读者区分 human preference、terminal label、DPO pair、ORM score 与 Best-of-k selection score。

对于 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes 赛道，two-buffer lineage 是最主要的可复用经验。正确轨迹改善 generator，接受和拒绝的轨迹共同改善 verifier，后续 generator 轮次则刷新 error distribution。这一配方可指导所有具有可靠 terminal predicate 的 self-training 实验，包括 mathematics、code、formal proof 或受约束的 tool task。

负责任的复用需要重建缺失的 audit layer。应固定 source dataset 与 base checkpoint，保存 query ID、generation seed、iteration ID、raw outcome、execution error 和 pair provenance；测量 label error 与 pair imbalance；对 verifier score 做 normalization 和 calibration；并在 verifier 训练时未见过的 generator 上测试 false positive、false negative 与 gaming。untrusted code 必须在有文档的 sandbox 中运行。

该方法不应被重新标成 process supervision 或 RLVR。它使用 SFT 训练 generator，使用 offline DPO 训练 verifier，并在测试时用 verifier ranking。把它扩展到 policy optimization 或 open-ended feedback，需要新的 reward contract 与新证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Section 3 with Algorithm 1: only correct samples enter D_GEN, all labeled samples enter D_VER, and the final DPO pairs are same-query correct-versus-incorrect Cartesian products.
  • Keep the budgets distinct: 3 training iterations × 16 candidates equals 48 candidates per query; main test metrics estimate Best-of-64 from 128 candidates; the large-k GSM8K plot uses 1,000 generations.
  • Treat GSM8K answer equality and MBPP test passing as terminal outcome labels, not validation of every rationale step or complete program semantics.
  • Read Sections 4.4-4.7 as boundaries: DPO beats the tested LoRA ORM, Best-of-k saturates at k of at least 16, and putting the verifier in the MBPP training loop yields no substantial gain.
  • Before reuse, account for the absent official code, buffers, pair manifest, checkpoints, hyperparameters, execution sandbox, split IDs, calibration, and decontamination audit.

• 结合 Algorithm 1 阅读 Section 3：只有正确样本进入 D_GEN，所有带标签样本进入 D_VER，最终 DPO pairs 是同题正确解与错误解的 Cartesian products。
  • 区分不同预算：3 轮训练 × 16 个候选等于每题 48 个候选；主测试指标从 128 个候选估计 Best-of-64；large-k GSM8K 图使用 1,000 次生成。
  • 把 GSM8K answer equality 和 MBPP test passing 视为 terminal outcome label，而不是对每个 rationale step 或完整 program semantics 的验证。
  • 把 Sections 4.4-4.7 作为边界阅读：DPO 优于受测 LoRA ORM，Best-of-k 在 k 至少为 16 时饱和，把 verifier 放入 MBPP training loop 也没有显著收益。
  • 复用前应处理官方代码、buffer、pair manifest、checkpoint、hyperparameter、execution sandbox、split ID、calibration 与 decontamination audit 的缺失。

引用

value.html: The verifier observes only the task and a completed text solution or program. It does not receive step-level labels, execution traces, hidden tests, counterexamples, or localized error annotations.

value_zh.html: 验证器仅观察任务与已完成的文本解答或程序。它不接收步骤级标签、执行痕迹、隐藏测试、反例或局部错误标注。

value.html: Mathematics outputs a chain-of-thought rationale ending in a final answer; code outputs a Python implementation. The DPO verifier consumes the problem and full candidate solution, and its scalar ranking signal at inference is the likelihood of that solution under the verifier, not a separately trained scalar head.

value_zh.html: 数学输出以最终答案结尾的思维链理由；代码输出 Python 实现。DPO 验证器消耗问题与完整候选解答，其在推断时的标量排序信号是该解答在验证器下的似然，而非单独训练的标量头。

value.html: The current generator self-samples complete mathematical rationales or Python programs. In the main recipe, the next generator is trained on accumulated correct samples, while the final verifier is trained on accumulated correct and incorrect samples. There is no external reasoning teacher or human preference annotator.

value_zh.html: 当前生成器自采样完整数学理由或 Python 程序。在主配方中，下一生成器在累积正确样本上训练，而最终验证器在累积正确与不正确样本上训练。无外部推理教师或人工偏好标注者。

value.html: Mathematics uses offline answer comparison. Code uses a Python test-execution harness over MBPP candidates, but sandboxing, timeout, resource limits, interpreter version, dependency versions, and complete test visibility are not disclosed.

value_zh.html: 数学使用离线答案比较。代码对 MBPP 候选使用 Python 测试执行工具，但沙箱、超时、资源限制、解释器版本、依赖版本与完整测试可见性未披露。

value.html: Mixed contract: programmatic answer or test checks label candidate outcomes; correct and incorrect candidates become synthetic preference pairs; a DPO-trained language model learns to rank full solutions. The learned verifier predicts outcome quality only and does not validate individual reasoning steps.

value_zh.html: 混合契约：程序性答案或测试检查为候选结果打标签；正确与不正确候选成为合成偏好对；经 DPO 训练的语言模型学习对完整解答排序。习得验证器仅预测结果质量，不验证各个推理步骤。

value.html: A math completion is correct when its extracted final answer matches the reference; a code completion is correct when it passes all invoked tests. Extraction rules, tolerance, equivalent-answer handling, malformed-output policy, and hidden-test coverage are unknown.

value_zh.html: 当提取的最终答案与参考匹配时，数学补全为正确；当通过全部所调用测试时，代码补全为正确。提取规则、容差、等价答案处理、畸形输出策略与隐藏测试覆盖未知。

value.html: Original GSM8K or MBPP query/solution -> base or SFT generator -> 16 candidates per query -> final-answer or test label -> correct candidates accumulated in D_GEN and all candidates accumulated in D_VER -> generator retrained from the base model on D_GEN -> three collection iterations -> same-problem Cartesian preference pairs -> DPO verifier -> Best-of-k candidate ranking.

value_zh.html: 原始 GSM8K 或 MBPP 查询/解答 -> 基座或 SFT 生成器 -> 每个查询 16 个候选 -> 最终答案或测试标签 -> 正确候选累积到 D_GEN、全部候选累积到 D_VER -> 生成器在 D_GEN 上从基座模型重新训练 -> 三次收集迭代 -> 同问题笛卡尔偏好对 -> DPO 验证器 -> Best-of-k 候选排序。

value.html: A task is a GSM8K word problem with a reference numeric answer or an MBPP function specification whose candidate program can be executed against tests. V-STaR uses the same training query repeatedly across generator iterations.

value_zh.html: 任务是带参考数值答案的 GSM8K 应用题，或候选程序可对测试执行的 MBPP 函数规格。V-STaR 在生成器迭代中重复使用同一训练查询。

value.html: The reusable raw verifier record is a problem, one complete generated solution, an iteration identifier, and a binary outcome label. For DPO, all correct and incorrect solutions for the same problem are expanded into ordered correct-versus-incorrect pairs by a Cartesian product. Original SFT solutions are also treated as correct examples in both generator and verifier buffers.

value_zh.html: 可复用的原始验证器记录是一个问题、一个完整生成解答、一个迭代标识符与一个二元结果标签。对 DPO，同一问题的全部正确与不正确解答通过笛卡尔积扩展为有序的正确对不正确对。原始 SFT 解答在生成器与验证器缓冲区中也被视为正确示例。

value.html: Native construction feedback is binary outcome correctness: final-answer equality for GSM8K and passing all available tests for MBPP. Pairwise DPO supervision is derived mechanically from that label. At deployment, the verifier supplies a sequence-likelihood ranking score for Best-of-k selection.

value_zh.html: 原生构建反馈是二元结果正确性：GSM8K 的最终答案相等，以及 MBPP 通过全部可用测试。成对 DPO 监督由该标签机械派生。部署时，验证器为 Best-of-k 选择提供序列似然排序分数。

value.html: LLaMA2 7B and 13B for mathematics and CodeLLaMA 7B and 13B for code, all adapted with LoRA. The paper also compares headline results with larger untuned baselines, but those larger models are not V-STaR training bases. Exact checkpoint revisions and tokenizer versions are unknown.

value_zh.html: 数学用 LLaMA2 7B 与 13B，代码用 CodeLLaMA 7B 与 13B，全部以 LoRA 适配。论文还将标题结果与更大的未调基线比较，但那些更大模型不是 V-STaR 训练基座。精确 checkpoint 修订与 tokenizer 版本未知。

value.html: No external teacher generates reasoning. The previous iteration's generator supplies candidates; GSM8K reference answers and MBPP test executions supply binary labels. The resulting correct-over-incorrect preference is synthetic outcome supervision, not a human preference.

value_zh.html: 无外部教师生成推理。上一迭代的生成器提供候选；GSM8K 参考答案与 MBPP 测试执行提供二元标签。所得正确优于不正确偏好是合成结果监督，而非人工偏好。

value.html: Fine-tune a base model on original plus accumulated correct solutions, sample new candidates, label them, and repeat. The paper describes each updated generator as fine-tuning the pretrained base model on the enlarged D_GEN rather than simply continuing the previous generator checkpoint.

value_zh.html: 在原始加累积正确解答上微调基座模型，采样新候选，为其打标签，并重复。论文将每个更新的生成器描述为在扩大的 D_GEN 上微调预训练基座模型，而非简单继续上一生成器 checkpoint。

value.html: GSM8K and MBPP training queries. Appendix B gives the three-shot MBPP generation prompt with task descriptions, assertions, and Python examples. The complete GSM8K prompt, answer-extraction implementation, exact query IDs, and prompt version are not released.

value_zh.html: GSM8K 与 MBPP 训练查询。Appendix B 给出带任务描述、断言与 Python 示例的三样本 MBPP 生成提示。完整 GSM8K 提示、答案提取实现、精确查询 IDs 与提示版本未发布。

value.html: Main experiments run three iterations and sample 16 completions per training query from the previous iteration's generator, for 48 generated candidates per query. GSM8K iteration 1 samples from a generator SFT-trained on GSM8K for two epochs; MBPP iteration 1 uses three-shot prompting of pretrained CodeLLaMA.

value_zh.html: 主实验运行三次迭代，并从上一迭代生成器为每个训练查询采样 16 个补全，即每个查询 48 个生成候选。GSM8K 迭代 1 从在 GSM8K 上 SFT 训练两个 epochs 的生成器采样；MBPP 迭代 1 使用预训练 CodeLLaMA 的三样本提示。

value.html: unknown

value_zh.html: 未知

value.html: Training-time exploration is independent repeated sampling, not tree search. At test time, generate a candidate pool, score each complete candidate with the DPO verifier, and select the highest-scoring one. The main algorithm does not put the verifier inside the generator-training loop.

value_zh.html: 训练时探索是独立重复采样，而非树搜索。测试时生成候选池，用 DPO 验证器为每个完整候选打分，并选择得分最高者。主算法不将验证器放入生成器训练循环内。

value.html: Construction uses a binary terminal check, not a learned-score threshold. Inference selects the maximum verifier-likelihood candidate from the sampled set. Score ties, length normalization, calibration, and abstention are not specified.

value_zh.html: 构建使用二元终态检查，而非习得分数阈值。推断从采样集中选择验证器似然最大的候选。分数平局、长度归一化、校准与弃权未指定。

value.html: Correct outcomes enter D_GEN; both correct and incorrect outcomes enter D_VER. For each query, every available correct solution is paired with every available incorrect solution. Exact deduplication, pair subsampling, class balancing, malformed-output handling, and per-iteration buffer counts are unknown.

value_zh.html: 正确结果进入 D_GEN；正确与不正确结果均进入 D_VER。对每个查询，每个可用正确解答与每个可用不正确解答配对。精确去重、对子采样、类别平衡、畸形输出处理与逐迭代缓冲区计数未知。

value.html: Main verifier results report Best-of-64 estimated from a fixed pool of 128 candidates per test problem. A GSM8K scaling analysis subsamples from 1,000 generations. Best-of-k saturates at k of at least 16 in the main 7B curves, and the advantage over majority vote narrows at larger k.

value_zh.html: 主验证器结果报告从每个测试问题固定的 128 候选池估计的 Best-of-64。GSM8K 扩展分析从 1,000 次生成中子采样。Best-of-k 在主 7B 曲线上于 k 至少为 16 时饱和，且相对多数投票的优势在更大 k 处收窄。

value.html: Generators use causal language-model SFT and verifiers use DPO with an SFT reference policy; all reported V-STaR models use LoRA. The DPO reference policy is trained on original GSM8K for two epochs or MBPP for three epochs. Learning rates, batch sizes, LoRA ranks, selected DPO beta, schedules, sequence limits, seeds, and hardware are not disclosed in the paper.

value_zh.html: 生成器使用因果语言模型 SFT，验证器使用带 SFT 参考策略的 DPO；全部报告的 V-STaR 模型使用 LoRA。DPO 参考策略在原始 GSM8K 上训练两个 epochs 或在 MBPP 上训练三个 epochs。学习率、batch sizes、LoRA ranks、选定的 DPO beta、调度、序列限制、种子与硬件未在论文中披露。

value.html: The paper does not release an immutable generated-solution corpus or report exact accepted, rejected, and Cartesian-pair counts. The nominal main budget is 48 generated candidates per training query, but realized pair counts depend on each query's correct/incorrect balance.

value_zh.html: 论文未发布不可变的生成解答语料，也未报告精确接受、拒绝与笛卡尔对计数。名义主预算为每个训练查询 48 个生成候选，但实现对数取决于每个查询的正确/不正确平衡。

value.html: The mathematics pipeline uses GSM8K only and the code pipeline uses MBPP only for training. MATH and HumanEval are transfer evaluation. Original supervised solutions and self-generated outcomes share the same buffers but are not separately weighted in the disclosed recipe. Exact upstream revisions and licenses are not pinned.

value_zh.html: 数学流水线训练仅使用 GSM8K，代码流水线训练仅使用 MBPP。MATH 与 HumanEval 为迁移评测。原始监督解答与自生成结果共享同一缓冲区，但在所披露配方中未分别加权。精确上游修订与许可未钉扎。

value.html: Training uses GSM8K and MBPP training data; evaluation uses their full stated test sets plus 150 numeric-answer, no-LaTeX, Level 1 MATH problems and the full HumanEval test set for transfer. Immutable task IDs, the exact MATH subset manifest, and generation seeds are not released.

value_zh.html: 训练使用 GSM8K 与 MBPP 训练数据；评测使用其完整所述测试集，外加 150 道数值答案、无 LaTeX、Level 1 MATH 问题以及完整 HumanEval 测试集用于迁移。不可变任务 IDs、精确 MATH 子集清单与生成种子未发布。

value.html: The paper separates named train and test splits and uses MATH/HumanEval for transfer, but reports no semantic-duplicate audit, pretraining-contamination analysis, or source-level check between GSM8K and the selected MATH problems or between MBPP and HumanEval.

value_zh.html: 论文分离具名 train 与 test 划分并使用 MATH/HumanEval 做迁移，但未报告语义重复审计、预训练污染分析，或 GSM8K 与所选 MATH 问题之间、或 MBPP 与 HumanEval 之间的来源级检查。

value.html: The recipe retains correct and incorrect generated solutions in D_VER, which is its main data-efficiency contribution. Only correct solutions enter D_GEN. Because the buffers are not released, it is unknown whether malformed, duplicate, timed-out, or execution-error candidates are retained and how those cases are labeled.

value_zh.html: 该配方在 D_VER 中保留正确与不正确的生成解答，这是其主要数据效率贡献。仅正确解答进入 D_GEN。因为缓冲区未发布，未知畸形、重复、超时或执行错误候选是否被保留，以及这些情形如何被打标签。

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: False positives arise from lucky final answers, incomplete code tests, memorized patterns, or candidate styles preferred by the learned likelihood even when reasoning is invalid.
False negatives arise from alternative valid derivations, equivalent formatting, correct programs outside the test harness's expected form, or length/style shift.

Ranking is not calibrated classification: the model's sequence likelihood is used comparatively within a candidate pool, with no reported probability calibration, abstention, refresh trigger, or cross-generator threshold.

The verifier is exposed to reward gaming when a generator adapts to its stylistic preferences. The main method avoids using it to label training outcomes, but deployment still selects whatever completion maximizes the learned score.
假阳性来自侥幸最终答案、不完整代码测试、记忆模式，或即使推理无效仍被习得似然偏好的候选风格。
假阴性来自替代有效推导、等价格式化、测试工具期望形式之外的正确程序，或长度/风格偏移。
排序不是校准分类：模型的序列似然在候选池内比较使用，无报告的概率校准、弃权、刷新触发或跨生成器阈值。
当生成器适应其风格偏好时，验证器暴露于奖励博弈。主方法避免用它为训练结果打标签，但部署仍选择使习得分数最大化的任何补全。
Final-answer equality can label an invalid mathematical rationale as positive when it happens to end at the correct number.
Answer extraction and formatting can create false negatives for equivalent math answers; the parser and tolerance rules are not released.
Passing available MBPP tests does not prove general program correctness and can reward test-specific or brittle code.
Executing untrusted generated code requires sandbox, timeout, and resource controls that the paper does not document.
Cartesian expansion reuses the same candidates in many correlated pairs and can overweight queries with many positives or negatives.
A verifier trained on the evolving generator's own errors may learn generator-specific style or shortcut features rather than portable correctness.
Raw sequence likelihood may depend on answer length and formatting; the paper does not specify length normalization or calibration.
Outcome supervision does not localize the first erroneous reasoning step or distinguish partially correct solutions.
Best-of-k gains consume additional inference compute and are estimated from a fixed candidate pool under a no-tied-scores formula assumption.
No official code, generated buffers, pair manifests, model checkpoints, or exact hyperparameter configuration were confirmed.
最终答案相等可能在无效数学理由碰巧以正确数字结尾时将其标为正。
答案提取与格式化可能对等价数学答案造成假阴性；解析器与容差规则未发布。
通过可用 MBPP 测试并不能证明一般程序正确性，且可能奖励测试特定或脆弱代码。
执行不可信生成代码需要沙箱、超时与资源控制，而论文未记录这些。
笛卡尔扩展在许多相关对中重复使用同一候选，并可能使具有许多正例或负例的查询过重。
在演化生成器自身错误上训练的验证器可能学习生成器特定风格或捷径特征，而非可迁移的正确性。
原始序列似然可能依赖于答案长度与格式化；论文未指定长度归一化或校准。
结果监督不定位第一个错误推理步骤，也不区分部分正确的解答。
Best-of-k 增益消耗额外推断计算，并在无平局分数公式假设下从固定候选池估计。
未确认官方代码、生成缓冲区、对清单、模型 checkpoints 或精确超参数配置。

value.html: arXiv v2 declares CC BY-SA 4.0 for the paper, and the University of Edinburgh record labels its accepted manuscript Creative Commons Attribution. No official code, generated dataset, or checkpoint release was confirmed, so there is no artifact license for the V-STaR buffers or models. Reimplementation must separately audit GSM8K, MBPP, LLaMA2, and CodeLLaMA terms.

value_zh.html: arXiv v2 声明论文为 CC BY-SA 4.0，University of Edinburgh 记录将其录用稿标注为 Creative Commons Attribution。未确认官方代码、生成数据集或 checkpoint 发布，因此 V-STaR 缓冲区或模型无产物许可。再实现必须单独审计 GSM8K、MBPP、LLaMA2 与 CodeLLaMA 条款。

value.html: Dataset query -> original or generated full solution -> binary programmatic label -> iteration-specific D_GEN/D_VER membership -> accumulated correct/incorrect pools -> Cartesian DPO pair -> verifier likelihood -> Best-of-k selection. No released row IDs, generation seeds, model hashes, labels, pair manifest, or final checkpoints make this lineage independently replayable.

value_zh.html: 数据集查询 -> 原始或生成的完整解答 -> 二元程序性标签 -> 迭代特定 D_GEN/D_VER 成员资格 -> 累积正确/不正确池 -> 笛卡尔 DPO 对 -> 验证器似然 -> Best-of-k 选择。无已发布的行 IDs、生成种子、模型哈希、标签、对清单或最终 checkpoints，使此谱系无法独立回放。
